name: KTX-Software
role: Khronos KTX2 texture tools: create, validate, inspect, extract
notes: 2026-11-27: Lead said version 5.0.0 and no macOS installer; the latest stable release is v4.4.2 (2025-10-04) and ships a Darwin-arm64 .pkg. 5.0.0 exists only as release candidates.
2026-11-27: Licence is Apache-2.0 for repository-own files with many other open licences for bundled code; check LICENSE.md before redistributing.

evidence.result: 256x256 RGBA PNG to UASTC KTX2 with 9 mip levels: validate valid, info reports KHR_DF_MODEL_UASTC and sRGB, extract level 0 PSNR 54.5 dB (max error 3, tolerance 40 dB and 16); two --threads 1 encodes identical.
evidence.scope: ktx 4.4.2 from expanded official pkg, macOS arm64, one generated image, UASTC only; not ETC1S, GPU use, glTF Transform integration or photographic quality.

summary: Khronos reference tools for KTX2 GPU textures. The unified ktx command creates Basis ETC1S or UASTC textures with mipmaps and zstd, then validates, inspects and extracts them; glTF Transform's KTX2 commands rely on it.
use_when: Compress textures to KTX2 (UASTC or ETC1S) for a 3D asset pipeline
Validate or inspect a KTX2 file's format, levels and colour model
avoid_when: Need to edit glTF scenes, not just textures: glTF Transform
license: Apache-2.0 for repository-own files; bundled third-party code under other open licences (see LICENSE.md)

install.macos: download KTX-Software-4.4.2-Darwin-arm64.pkg from the v4.4.2 release, check SHA-256 500bd8f9d63358c3f3a0d83b724c8574436a72c37dc0e4bad90ec1ca38032c3c, then pkgutil --expand-full it into a project folder and copy ktx and libktx* into bin/ and lib/ (examples/ktx-software-roundtrip/run.sh does this); system install: sudo installer -pkg <pkg> -target /

assessment.rationale: Official Khronos reference tools with a documented scriptable ktx CLI; repo pushed 2026-11-17 and a 5.0.0 release candidate is out. glTF Transform's KTX2 commands depend on it.
